android.desc:
Flow is your ultimate productivity companion, designed to help you achieve deep focus and crush your goals. Whether you're a student, professional, or anyone battling distractions, Flow combines powerful tools like customizable timers and smart reminders to keep you in the zone.
Key Features:

-> Pomodoro & Timers: Classic 25/5 sessions or count-up timers for flexible work.
-> Time Boxing: Chain sessions with custom durations and breaks for structured days.
-> Flow Triggers: Schedule sessions with reminders and one-tap "Start Now" buttons.
-> App Blocking: Block distracting apps like Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, or games during focus mode.
-> Leaderboard & Social: Compete with friends or globally to build accountability.
-> Metrics & Insights: Track focus score, 3-4 month heatmaps, streaks, pie charts for tag breakdowns, and trend lines to optimize habits.

Accessibility Service Usage:
Flow uses Android's Accessibility Service solely to power the App Blocking feature. When enabled, it detects when a user opens a blocked app and immediately redirects them away, keeping distracting apps inaccessible during focus sessions. This service is only active when App Blocking is turned on by the user, is never used to collect or transmit any personal data, and is not used for any purpose other than enforcing the user's chosen app blocks.
Flow is ad-free, privacy-focused, and built for real results. Join thousands boosting productivity — download now and find your flow!
